aboutGame.title: What is Frostrail?
paragraphs: Frostrail is a frozen-world survival FPS from developer FakeFish and publisher Shiro Unlimited. You play as one of the Penitent Gardeners, mercy-givers who purge Revenants and eldritch horrors from an empire ruined by the Emperor's pact with the Void.

Your armored steam train, the Eden Engine, is home, furnace, workshop, and lifeline. Fuel it, reinforce it, and add carriages and crafting stations, then push north through abandoned settlements, wreckage, dungeons, and vaults for materials, Relics, and weapons. Play solo or with a co-op crew.

modules.name: Frostrail Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the core Frostrail loop: prepare aboard the Eden Engine, scout exits, scavenge frozen levels, and return with materials before the cold wins.

highlights.detail: Stoke the Eden Engine, check the cab heat, and top off fuel before leaving the train.
Scout the level exits first, then loot with a time budget instead of panic.
Refine metal scraps into slag metal and then pure metal at the onboard refinery.
Save scarce ammunition for Revenants and elites, and use melee finishers on wounded enemies.
Return to the train with enough fuel for the trip back and repair gear before the next run.

modules.name: Frostrail Train Upgrades
modules.description: Keep the Eden Engine fueled, repaired, and reinforced, then expand storage, carriages, and crafting stations as your crew pushes north.

highlights.label: Engine
highlights.detail: Fuel the Eden Engine first; a stalled train in open cold ends the run.

highlights.label: Repairs
highlights.detail: Repair damaged systems before buying new modules so breakdowns do not compound.

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: Add storage and hauling capacity so valuable loot comes home instead of being left behind.

highlights.label: Defense
highlights.detail: Reinforce walls, hatches, and doors to keep boarders off the train during defense events.

highlights.label: Carriages
highlights.detail: Expand with carriages for workstations, refining, and shared crew inventory.

highlights.label: Boarding
highlights.detail: Use the improved access ramp and clear windows to board and exit faster under pressure.

modules.name: Frostrail Survival Tips
modules.description: Manage heat, clothing, food buffs, ammunition, and blizzards while exploring far from the train's warmth.

highlights.label: Heat
highlights.detail: Warmth comes from the Eden Engine; never let the fire die before a long interior crawl.

highlights.label: Clothing
highlights.detail: Insulation sets extend how far you can travel from the cab before the cold bites.

highlights.label: Food
highlights.detail: Food grants buffs rather than filling a hunger meter, so eat before fights and deep runs.

highlights.label: Ammo
highlights.detail: Ammunition is scarce; count engagements before you fire and finish wounded enemies in melee.

highlights.label: Blizzard
highlights.detail: Blizzards cut visibility and movement, so plan shorter routes when the weather turns.

highlights.label: Fuel
highlights.detail: Branches, logs, and charcoal feed the engine; never leave a town with a low reserve.

modules.name: Frostrail Crafting and Resources
modules.description: Refine metal scraps, wood, plastic, and cloth at onboard stations, then craft ammunition, gear, and modular weapons for the next expedition.

highlights.label: Scrap
highlights.detail: Metal scraps refine into slag metal, then pure metal for repairs and weapon parts.

highlights.label: Wood
highlights.detail: Wood follows a multi-step refinement chain and also feeds the Eden Engine as logs and branches.

highlights.label: Plastic
highlights.detail: Plastic follows a similar refinement path and supports gear and station construction.

highlights.label: Cloth
highlights.detail: Cloth becomes cold-mitigation clothing for expeditions beyond the cab.

highlights.label: Fuel
highlights.detail: Branches, logs, and charcoal are fuel inputs, so crafting and travel compete for the same pile.

highlights.label: Bench
highlights.detail: Crafting benches, refineries, and the Assembly Station travel with the train.

modules.name: Frostrail Weapons and Combat
modules.description: Compare Frostrail weapon roles, from the modular Bolt-Action Rifle and close-range shotguns to pistols and melee finishers.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Bolt-Action Rifle - modular platform assembled at the Assembly Station for deliberate mid-range shots.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Shotgun - close-range burst against humanoid Revenants; make every shell count.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Rifle - mid-range precision to pick threats before they close on the crew.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Pistol - cheap backup shots and light Revenant cleanup when ammo is tight.

modules.name: Frostrail Co-op Guide
modules.description: Split Engineer, Quartermaster, Scavenger, and Vanguard duties so a Frostrail crew keeps the train warm and the expeditions supplied.

highlights.detail: Agree on roles before departure: Engineer, Quartermaster, Scavenger, and Vanguard.
Keep one player aboard to feed the Eden Engine and watch the cab heat while others loot.
Share storage and crafting duties so ammunition, food, and repair materials stay stocked.
Rotate the Scavenger and call retreats together instead of letting one player overextend.
Play the same survival loop solo or with friends; co-op adds tempo and shared risk.

modules.name: Frostrail Enemies and Locations
modules.description: Track Revenants, wolves, settlements, wreckage, dungeons, vaults, and bunkers across the frozen route north.

highlights.label: Revenants
highlights.detail: Humanoid enemies and elites guard interiors and punish careless ammo use.

highlights.label: Wolves
highlights.detail: Hostile creatures pressure expeditions away from the train and chase stragglers.

highlights.label: Towns
highlights.detail: Abandoned settlements provide supplies, equipment, and environmental storytelling.

highlights.label: Wreckage
highlights.detail: Salvage beside the rails is a low-risk stop for scrap and basic materials.

highlights.label: Dungeons
highlights.detail: Modular dungeons shift layout between runs and pay out Relics for the train.

highlights.label: Vaults
highlights.detail: Subterranean vaults are high-risk interiors with powerful weapons as rewards.

highlights.label: Bunkers
highlights.detail: Derelict bunkers offer enclosed exploration and tight combat against Revenants.

faq.title: Frostrail FAQ
faq.description: Answers to common questions about Frostrail survival, co-op, crafting, weapons, the Eden Engine, and release plans.

items.question: What is Frostrail?
items.answer: Frostrail is a frozen-world survival FPS from FakeFish and Shiro Unlimited. You play as a Penitent Gardener, scavenging a ruined empire, fighting Revenants and eldritch horrors, and keeping an armored steam train called the Eden Engine alive.

items.question: Can you play Frostrail solo or in co-op?
items.answer: Yes. Steam lists both single-player and online co-op, and the official FAQ confirms crews of one to four players. Co-op splits fuel, crafting, scavenging, and combat duties across the crew.

items.question: How do you stay warm in Frostrail?
items.answer: Heat comes from the Eden Engine. Keep it fueled with branches, logs, and charcoal, wear insulation sets away from the cab, and return before your fuel reserve runs low.

items.question: How does crafting work in Frostrail?
items.answer: Crafting runs through train-mounted benches, refineries, and the Assembly Station. Metal scraps become slag metal and then pure metal, while wood and plastic follow similar refinement chains for gear, repairs, and modular weapons.

items.question: What weapons are in Frostrail?
items.answer: Frostrail uses WWI-influenced firearms, including the Pipe Rifle, the modular Bolt-Action Rifle, pistols, shotguns, rifles, and machine guns, with melee attacks as a backup. Ammunition is scarce, so shot discipline matters.

items.question: When can you play Frostrail?
items.answer: The Frostrail demo runs on Steam from October 19 to October 26, 2026. Early Access is planned for Q4 2026, and wishlisting the game is the reliable way to hear about future playtests.
